_provenance.scope: Pooled vision-tower baselines from large multimodal-model pipelines. These are visual embeddings, not end-to-end language-model outputs or generative answers.
_provenance.comparison_boundary: HDD and seed-42 VCDB use the same population and metric definitions as the DRT lanes, but these two configurations are absent from synthesis v8 and common-backbone values differ across caches/configurations. Show them as a separate inset and never insert them into or use them to rerank the v8 scorecard.
_provenance.other_large_models: Gemini 3.1 Pro and Claude Opus 4.6 direct-prompt values appear only in manuscript text; their raw result JSONs are absent. Qwen3-VL, Gemma 4, and LLaVA-Video prompt values are aggregate transcriptions without raw per-clip responses. The defective integrity summary is withdrawn. None of those prompt results are rendered on the poster.

protocols.vcdb: Copy AP on 527 videos, 5,585 positives, and 5,585 seed-42 matched random negatives.
protocols.hdd: Global AP on 1,687 segments and 97,731 within-cluster pairs, including 43,673 positives; chance floor 0.446869.
